Besançon

Tuesday 29 December 2026

On Tuesday 29 December, the cyclo-cross peloton returns to Besançon. After a year of absence, the French race is once again part of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup. In 2024, Fem van Empel and Mathieu van der Poel secured victory. Who will follow in their footsteps?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Besançon on Tuesday 29 December? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €15.00 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €28.00 (service fee included)

Children born in 2015 or later: €2.50 (service fee included)

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://besancon.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)
